scope: Local installed Chrome, 20 ordinary password-authenticated contexts, 100 warm full dashboard navigations. SQL checks all fixture rows and actual visible financial values; local measurements do not establish deployment equivalence or whole CNF-01 acceptance.

environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on aarch64-apple-darwin25.3.0, compiled by clang version 21.1.7, 64-bit

instance.applicationMode: next start after production build; isolated local machine; no deployment equivalence claimed

managedProfiles.scope: Fresh Next Node/JavaScript process per wave; persisted SQL FX remains valid. No OS, filesystem, Supabase, or browser-cache cold claim. Providers are explicit local doubles, never real integrations.
managedProfiles.providerMode: Explicit loopback HTTP provider double; no real integration

network.scope: Per browser target; not a shared 20 Mbps pipe and not server-to-provider shaping
network.browserHttpCache: Disabled implicitly by Playwright routing used for the loopback guard; warmup refers to application/server state and persisted quote cache

summary.percentileMethod: Nearest rank over all recorded durations, including errors and timeouts; no failed sample removed

warm.measurementBoundary: Immediately before page.goto through correct own net worth/month income-expense-balance, all ten account cards/links and five recent descriptions matching independent full SQL AND effective opacity (element times all ancestors)>=0.99. This conservative boundary includes entrance animations, rather than stopping at DOM-ready/Playwright visible. Login, post-measurement screenshots and SQL integrity checks excluded; every navigation error/timeout remains in its profile denominator.

localThreshold.required: p95 < 2000 ms AND zero failed observations AND successful warmup

processEvents.readiness: /api/health only; dashboard not visited by controller

coldStart.sessionScope: The same 20 normally authenticated browser contexts retain sessions across five owned Next process restarts; no login occurs in the measured boundary.
